title: Evidence ingestion configuration
description: The ingestion configuration, checked in full before any network request. Every path is a literal native path on the submitting host, never a historic report-reference string from an observation. The token file holds the bearer token; its contents are never logged. The ingestion CLI (`cli/ingest.ts`) takes these values as flags (`--endpoint`, `--repo`, `--token-file`, `--state`) and builds `proofs` from `--proof-dir`: each report path, and each proof's `{package}-{gate}.expected.json` and `.completion.json`, resolved inside that directory.

endpoint.description: Service origin, without the `/v1` prefix: `https://host[:port]`, or `http://` only for a loopback host (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`) such as a local `wrangler dev`. No path, query, or credentials.

token_file.description: Owner-only file holding the bearer token.

state_path.description: Where resume state is written atomically.

proofs.description: Explicit map from each observation reference to upload to the local file holding its bytes. References not listed are not uploaded. Empty means no uploads.
